name: Grants In Aid To SC/ST Patients Suffering From Cancer And Other Malignant Diseases
benefit: Under the scheme, such SC / ST patients will be given a one-time, fixed financial assistance of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand)
_eligibility_text: 1) The applicant must belong to an SC / ST community of Assam. 2) Person suffering from cancer or other malignant diseases may apply. 3) No person shall be eligible to claim this financial aid more than once.
